arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified evaluate(): it checks sorted missing required request conditions first; filters records by claim, non-withdrawn state, verification policy, and canonical-JSON equality for every required condition; applies supersession only among eligible records; reports no-match, conflict, supported, or Boolean-false unsupported with sorted source IDs; does not mutate inputs. Current report evaluates vertical_rate as supported 30 from S1 and device_validated as unsupported false from D1.
